```{r setup, include=FALSE}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(ISLR)
library(glmnet)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(purrr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lmtest)
library(nortest)
library(car)
library(readxl)

# Carga de datos
eph <- read_excel("data/eph.xlsx")
eph <- na.omit(eph)

set.seed(989269)

filas_train <- createDataPartition(eph$ingreso_hogar, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
entrenar <- eph[filas_train, ]
probar <- eph[-filas_train, ]

# Modelo 1: AIC
mod_aic <- stepAIC(
  object = lm(ingreso_ocup ~ 1, data = entrenar),
  scope = list(upper = lm(ingreso_ocup ~ sexo + edad + est_civil + region + horas_trabajo + educ_cat + formal + ant_laboral, data = entrenar)),
  direction = "forward", trace = FALSE
)

# Modelo 2: BIC
mod_baic <- stepAIC(
  object = lm(ingreso_ocup ~ 1, data = entrenar),
  scope = list(upper = lm(ingreso_ocup ~ sexo + edad + est_civil + region + horas_trabajo + educ_cat + formal + ant_laboral, data = entrenar)),
  direction = "forward", trace = FALSE, k = log(nrow(entrenar))
)

# Modelo 3: Propio
mod_propio <- lm(ingreso_ocup ~ educ_cat + horas_trabajo + formal, data = entrenar)

```

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false
criterios <- function(m) {
  SCE <- deviance(m)
  n <- length(residuals(m))
  p <- length(coefficients(m))
  cme <- SCE/(n-p)
  r2aj <- summary(m)$adj.r.squared
  tibble(CME = cme, R2Aj = r2aj, AIC = AIC(m), BIC = BIC(m))
}

map_dfr(list(mod_aic, mod_baic, mod_propio), criterios) %>% 
  mutate_all(round, 2) %>% 
  mutate(Modelo = c("Mod AIC", "Mod BAIC", "Modelo Propio")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Modelo, CME, "$R_{aj}^2$" = R2Aj, AIC, BIC) %>% 
  kable(escape = FALSE, caption = "Comparación de métricas de ajuste") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = F, latex_options = "hold_position") %>% 
  row_spec(1, background = "#A9F5A9")
```

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 4
#| layout-ncol: 2
plot(mod_aic, 1)
plot(mod_aic, 2)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
#  quarto render index.qmd && mv index.pdf ./doc/index.pdf


```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
